sentences.en: I have lived a life of a puppet of fortune.
sentences.zh: 我过着任由命运摆布的生活。

sentences.en: A puppet does not know that it is being controlled.
sentences.zh: 木偶不知道自己被操控。

sentences.en: During lessons I would often play with a finger puppet.
sentences.zh: 上课时我会经常玩手指上的小木偶。

senses.zh: 木偶，傀儡；傀儡政权，傀儡政府
